verdict.rationale: Deel's marketing docs say it can 'pay every worker type... from one platform', running payroll for employees, contractors, and EOR workers, which matches the core of the story. The evidence never mentions US W-2 employee payroll or 1099 contractor handling (tax forms, filings), and the claim comes only from marketing pages. missing for 10: explicit US W-2 payroll and 1099 contractor payment/tax-form documentation, detailed product docs on a unified pay run, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can pay both W-2 employees and 1099 contractors from one platform

citations.quote: Pay every worker type, in every country, from one platform.
Run accurate, compliant payroll for employees, contractors, and EOR workers across 150+ countries with unified data
